description: Consolidate AppLens documentation so it is accurate to the current implementation (after FEAT-001), with the broader spec vision presented as a clearly-labeled roadmap. Rewrite README.md as the single primary user-facing doc; create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as the final engineering spec; update CHANGELOG.md; reduce DELIVERY.md to a pointer; rewrite Example/README.md including a 'Testing AI capabilities' section for the FEAT-001 scenarios. Depends on FEAT-001 (docs must match the final code and the actual scenario set/questions it produced; read FEAT-001.json findings first).
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-final-revamp/features/FEAT-001.json findings to learn the final version (0.2.1 vs 0.2.0), the redaction behavior that shipped (header-only vs header+body), the exact scenario list/questions, and whether scenario #7 shipped. Docs MUST reflect those exact facts.

Rewrite README.md as the single primary user-facing doc: what AppLens is; install (file:../ dependency + the tsconfig paths mapping to src/index.ts); quick start with the REAL API (AppLens.initialize(config) and the AppLensUI component — NOT `<AppLens />`); a full config table with every field and default from context.json verified_facts (mark persistLogs and verboseLogging reserved/unused; document redaction.fields per the shipped behavior); a complete public API list including loadKnowledgeGraph, getKnowledgeGraph, attachInterceptors, detachInterceptors, isEnabled, reset, getVersion, getConfig, getStorage (README currently omits several); the 7 UI tabs; network/console/events/errors feature notes (50KB body truncation, Hermes-only rejection capture, NetworkRequest.context is Planned/not populated); a corrected Redaction section (header VALUES redacted by default via redactHeaders; body-field redaction = as shipped by FEAT-001, either wired via redaction.fields or Planned — be consistent); storage as an interface-level abstraction (note there is no public storage setter today); AI setup (lmstudio vs openai; iOS 127.0.0.1 vs Android 10.0.2.2 table; 'Serve on Local Network'; cleartext http; privacy = local by default, remote only when configured; REMOVE the false 'local provider returns canned guidance' claim — the local provider is an unconfigured stub that shows the Setup prompt); index-project.js usage (`node src/ai/index-project.js <path> > graph.json` then AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph); troubleshooting; and a link to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as the final engineering spec: product vision; SDK vs Developer Agent separation (note the Developer Agent is mostly Planned — only the Node-only CodeIndexer exists today); condensed core principles; current module architecture mapped to REAL files; real data types (NetworkRequest, LogEntry/LogLevel, AppEvent, AppError, AIMessage/AIConversation/ContextChunk, GraphNode/NodeType); the real storage interface; AI provider + model capabilities (real: OpenAIProvider, LocalAIProvider stub, createAIProvider, Confidence line, platform-aware connection help; planned: tool-use, streaming); context engine (what it assembles: network+console+events+errors+graph summary, keyword/recency ranked, ~8000-token budget, no runtime source reads); knowledge graph (manifest-driven via buildFromManifest; the indexer is REGEX/heuristic, NOT AST — correct the 'AST' comment claim in prose); security/privacy; performance guidance (ring buffers, 50KB truncation, token budget); an Implementation Status table marking each spec capability Implemented/Partial/Planned (Network/Console/Events/Errors Implemented; rejection capture Partial-Hermes; Redaction per shipped behavior; AI chat + Context engine Implemented; Knowledge graph + Code intelligence Partial; Agent tools, Tool-using AI, Code modification, Visual intelligence, runtime->source correlation Planned); a phased roadmap for spec phases 1-11 with status (1 Foundation, 2 Runtime Observability, 3 Developer UI, 4 Storage, 5 AI Foundation = done/partial; 6 Code Intelligence, 7 Knowledge Graph = Partial; 8 Agent Tools, 9 Tool-Using AI, 10 Code Modification, 11 Visual Intelligence = Planned); a 'Do not build yet' list (autonomous code modification, production monitoring, cloud analytics, device fleet, crash backend, full IDE, arbitrary shell, auto dependency install/upgrades); definitions of done; and a spec-vs-code divergence note (@app-lens->@applens, <AppLens />->AppLensUI, AppLensDebugUI->AppLensUI). NO Triveni Point naming anywhere.

Update CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog format): add this revamp entry — README rewrite, new docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, DELIVERY.md reduced to a pointer, Example AI Test Lab scenarios, corrected redaction docs, SettingsTab version fix, Example jest fix, and (if FEAT-001 wired it) the new body-field redaction via redaction.fields + redactFields export. Use '## [0.2.1]' if the version was bumped, else '## [Unreleased]'. Also add a Fixed/Docs note correcting the stale 0.2.0 claim that redactFields was 'used across the library'.

Reduce DELIVERY.md (decision D5) to a short pointer: keep the package/version header, replace the body with one paragraph directing readers to README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Remove or correct any residual 'canned guidance' / 'redactFields used across the library' claims.

Rewrite Example/README.md: what the ShopDemo Example is; prerequisites; run iOS (npm run ios, pod install) and Android (npm run android, note 10.0.2.2); configure LM Studio (load a model, enable Serve on Local Network, base URL per platform, aiModel must match the loaded model); a 'Testing AI capabilities' section listing each shipped AI Test Lab scenario with its exact tap-to-copy question and the expected kind of grounded answer (e.g. scenario 1 -> AI cites the 500 and checkout_failed event; scenario 6 -> AI reports Authorization is [REDACTED] and cannot disclose it); how to run index-project.js for scenario #7 if shipped; note AI replies end with a Confidence line; an offline note (scenarios still log + track; AI answers degrade). Generic only — NO Triveni Point.

Cross-check (decision in plan Item 9): grep every API/config/export name used in README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md against src/ to confirm each exists; grep both docs AND all Example files for 'Triveni' (must be zero); confirm all version strings agree across package.json, getVersion(), SettingsTab footer, README header, DELIVERY header, CHANGELOG top.
acceptance_criteria: README.md documents only APIs/config/exports that exist in src/ (verified by grep); the real component name AppLensUI is used and the spec `<AppLens />` divergence is noted in a roadmap/divergence section.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md exists with the implementation-status table, phased roadmap (phases 1-11), and 'Do not build yet' list, and marks capabilities honestly as Implemented/Partial/Planned.
No doc claims the local provider returns canned guidance; redaction docs match the shipped behavior; the indexer is described as heuristic (not AST).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this revamp with the correct version heading; DELIVERY.md is a short pointer.
Example/README.md has a 'Testing AI capabilities' section matching the actual FEAT-001 scenarios and questions.
`grep -ri triveni` across README.md, docs/, and Example/ returns zero matches.
verification: cd /Users/sunilkumar/Desktop/project/AppLens/AppLens && npx tsc --noEmit (docs changes must not break the lib type-check)
for each documented AppLens method/config field/export: grep -rn <name> src/ to confirm it exists
grep -n 0.2 package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md DELIVERY.md src/core/AppLens.ts src/tabs/SettingsTab.tsx (confirm version strings agree)
findings:
